info_cards.title: Notable Person: Malala Yousafzai
info_cards.fact: "One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world." — Pakistani activist for girls' education who became the youngest-ever Nobel Peace Prize laureate.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Greta Thunberg
info_cards.fact: "You are never too small to make a difference." — Swedish climate activist who began a global youth movement for climate action with her school strikes.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Barack Obama
info_cards.fact: "Change will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time. We are the ones we've been waiting for." — 44th U.S. president and the first African American to hold the office.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Angela Merkel
info_cards.fact: "We can do this." — German chancellor who led Germany for sixteen years and played a central role in European politics.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Kofi Annan
info_cards.fact: "Knowledge is power. Information is liberating." — Ghanaian diplomat who served as Secretary-General of the United Nations and won the Nobel Peace Prize.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Jacinda Ardern
info_cards.fact: "One of the things I'd like to think is people give a bit more credit to... kindness with strength." — New Zealand prime minister known for her crisis leadership and communication style.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Malcolm X
info_cards.fact: "Education is the passport to the future, for tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today." — American minister and human-rights activist who advocated for Black empowerment and self-determination.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Cesar Chavez
info_cards.fact: "We cannot seek achievement for ourselves and forget about progress and prosperity for our community." — American labor leader who co-founded the United Farm Workers union to advocate for farmworkers' rights.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Dolores Huerta
info_cards.fact: "Every moment is an organizing opportunity, every person a potential activist, every minute a chance to change the world." — American labor leader who co-founded the United Farm Workers union alongside Cesar Chavez.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Marie Marvingt
info_cards.fact: "Above all, do not give up." — French aviator and athlete known as 'the fiancée of danger' for her pioneering work in aviation and medicine.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Sally Ride
info_cards.fact: "I would like to be remembered as someone who was not afraid to do what she wanted to do." — American astronaut who became the first American woman in space in 1983.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Mae Jemison
info_cards.fact: "Never be limited by other people's limited imaginations." — American engineer and astronaut who became the first African American woman to travel into space.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Yuri Gagarin
info_cards.fact: "I see the Earth! It is so beautiful." — Soviet pilot and cosmonaut who became the first human to travel into outer space in 1961.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Valentina Tereshkova
info_cards.fact: "Once you've been in space, you appreciate how small and fragile this planet is." — Soviet cosmonaut who became the first woman in space in 1963.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Sundar Pichai
info_cards.fact: "Wear your failure as a badge of honor." — Indian-American businessman who serves as CEO of Google and its parent company, Alphabet.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Tu Youyou
info_cards.fact: "I love my work and there is nothing in the world I'd rather do." — Chinese pharmaceutical chemist who discovered artemisinin, a life-saving treatment for malaria, winning the Nobel Prize.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Frances Arnold
info_cards.fact: "You can use evolution to design new molecules... that solve today's problems." — American chemical engineer who won the Nobel Prize for pioneering directed evolution of enzymes.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Tawakkol Karman
info_cards.fact: "Peace cannot be achieved without women's full participation." — Yemeni journalist and activist who won the Nobel Peace Prize for her work promoting women's rights and democracy.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Denis Mukwege
info_cards.fact: "Healing is a journey... it requires us all." — Congolese gynecologist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate known for his work treating survivors of sexual violence.

info_cards.title: Notable Person: Abiy Ahmed
info_cards.fact: "We can either make the most of the rich, ample resources we have, or squander them." — Ethiopian prime minister who won the Nobel Peace Prize for ending a long conflict with neighboring Eritrea.
